# `redundant-inline`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports `inline for` or `inline while` already inside a comptime scope.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

The loop is already compile-time evaluated, so `inline` repeats a guarantee
supplied by the context.

## When it fires

It applies to loops lexically contained by a proven comptime block.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn f() void {
    comptime {
        inline for (0..3) |i| {
            _ = i;
        }
    }
}
```

Reference: <https://ziglang.org/documentation/master/#comptime>
